hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Intentional muted-pink palette and clean card layout show some design thought, but the 900px SVG is cropped in the viewport so the full visualization isn't visible, and the page is dominated by developer chrome (FPS display, debug controls, credits) that overwhelms the actual data graphic.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Encoding is honest throughout: scaleSqrt used correctly for force-layout circle sizing (line 490), ordinal color scale for categorical hierarchy, key functions present on data joins (d => d.id), and all layout domains derived from data — no bar/area zero-baseline violations apply to this chart type.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() is called before new layout transitions so rapid layout switching mid-animation risks jumpy/NaN path states; the tension slider fires redrawLinks() synchronously on every input event without RAF coalescing.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: The circle-pack hierarchy is readable but 300 random edges at 8% bundle tension converge into an opaque central hairball that makes individual connections untraceable without hover interaction, and the 8-layout control surface plus tension/easing/FPS controls add substantial cognitive overhead before the viewer reaches the data.
